creature_text.Text: Foolish mortal! You should have fled when you had the chance.
Arise, ghouls! Feast upon this intruder's heart!
Unacceptable! My minions will rip you apart!
creature_text.comment: Лиандра Солнечная Скиталица to Взрывающийся вурдалак

creature_text.Text: I will not be defeated! Come, my pet! Sate your hunger with the flesh of the living!
creature_text.comment: Лиандра Солнечная Скиталица to Горящий скелет

creature_text.Text: Enough of these games. This ends here!
If you long for my blade so badly, then you shall have it!
Awaken, Gorewing! Tear my foe asunder!

creature_text.comment: Лиандра Солнечная Скиталица to Кровокрыл Пробудившийся

creature_text.Text: An inglorious stain upon the Sunstrider name has been cleansed. Good work, hero!
creature_text.comment: Этас Похититель Солнца to Лиандра Солнечная Скиталица

creature_text.Text: Let's go... before the Lich King decides we've overstayed our welcome. I must plead my case before the council.
